unset.description: Properties to UNSET (RouterOS `!prop`), so they no longer apply — e.g. ['dst-address'] removes the destination-address match. snake_case or kebab-case. Not for setting a value.

name.description: Current name of the script to update

new_name.description: New name if renaming the script

source.description: Updated script source code, VERBATIM (may contain spaces/semicolons/quotes/newlines — they are quoted and escaped for the console automatically). Never HTML-escape it: pass `<`, `>`, `&` as themselves, since `<`/`>`/`&` are stored literally and break comparisons.

dont_require_permissions.description: Run without checking the policy permissions of the caller (yes/no)
